feature_descriptions.Enchanter: Gain the Mind sphere, or a Mind talent if already known.
feature_descriptions.Emotion: Choose a new minor emotion or advance a known emotion subject to its tier prerequisites.

resources.name: Hypnotism
resources.description: Daily uses equal 3 + half Eliciter level. Choose an available effect before spending a use.

resources.name: Hypnotism / Emotion DC
resources.description: 10 + half Eliciter level + Charisma modifier + Persuasive bonus.

resources.name: Convincing — Take 20
resources.description: Take 20 without additional time on Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, or Sense Motive. Uses improve at levels 13 and 17.

choice_providers.label: Emotions
choice_providers.description: Select a new minor emotion or advance a known emotion. Lesser requires level 5, greater level 8, and master level 11.

notes: Mid casting, Mind-sphere entry, spell points, hypnotism, Persuasive, emotions, and Convincing use shared declarations.
